task.label: 말끔한 19살(맑은데 끝에 살짝 거침)
texts: 거짓말. 안 켜면 그냥 안경이잖아. 난 모리. 근거 없는 말은 안 믿어. 그래서, 나랑 무슨 상관인데? 흐음, 인정. 이번엔 네 말이 맞았어.
task.instruct: Nineteen-year-old guy, clean youthful voice with a touch of gravel at the ends of phrases. Mid pitch, relaxed and sly, slightly lazy drawl but brisk overall tempo, amused and a bit skeptical, very clear pronunciation. Feels like a cool classmate, fresh and young, not deep, not mature.
